arguments.title: ColorVideoVDP: A visual difference predictor for image, video and display distortions
key_claims: This full-reference metric models color and luminance distortions over space/time under specified display/viewing conditions. It is useful for matched-scene encoding or renderer-difference diagnostics when those conditions are explicit. Comparing unrelated source-video and stage compositions is not a valid substitute for perceived design quality. The paper lacks higher-level saliency/annoyance modeling and does not establish music fit. Keep it secondary; a favorable score cannot promote a new lighting baseline.

Verified full PDF SHA256 ac8a791eac5bb5dbbc3a21e0796104439d5010862de6d3c1e82b4b6d4a0d5449. Read scope: Abstract; display model and opponent/temporal processing Sec3.1–3.2; stated limitations. Published evidence is outside LightSem; application here is a hypothesis.
